proc codegenFixpointRuleSets(ruleset_name: string; decls: seq[RelationDecl];
                             rules: seq[Rule]): NimNode {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}

Generates C++ code for fixpoint (recursive) rule sets with semi-naive evaluation.

This procedure implements the semi-naive evaluation strategy by generating multiple rule variants for each rule where an incremental relation appears in the body. For each occurrence of an incremental relation in a rule body, it creates a variant that uses DELTA_VER for that relation and FULL_VER for all other relations.

Parameters:

  • ruleset_name: The name of the fixpoint rule set
  • rules: Sequence of rules to generate variants for

Returns: NimNode containing the generated C++ code and type wrappers

The generated code includes:

  • Individual rule variants (e.g., RuleName_0, RuleName_1) for each position where an incremental relation appears in the body
  • Rule variant lists using Boost.MP11 mp_list for efficient type-level operations
  • A Fixpoint type that groups all rule variants together

Example: For a rule Path(x,z) :- Path(x,y), Edge(y,z) where Path is incremental, this generates a variant TCTransitive_0 that uses DELTA_VER for the first Path in the body and FULL_VER for Edge.
